-- helper for tweening planes
local function tweenPlane(plane, targetCFrame, time)
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(time, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, 0, false, 0)
    local tweenValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
    tweenValue.Value = plane:GetPrimaryPartCFrame()
    tweenValue.Changed:Connect(function()
        plane:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(tweenValue.Value)
    end)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(tweenValue, tweenInfo, { Value = targetCFrame })
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Wait()
end
